name: MQ-1C Gray Eagle
summary: Army medium-altitude long-endurance drone in the Predator family, powered by a heavy-fuel piston engine and armed with Hellfire missiles.

wings: Very long, narrow straight wing mounted mid-fuselage
engines: Single heavy-fuel piston engine driving a rear pusher propeller
fuselage: No cockpit: slender fuselage with a large bulbous nose hump for the satellite dish
Slimmer body than the larger Reaper
tail: Inverted V-tail with both surfaces pointing downward, below the propeller
Thin antenna masts standing up from the rear spine

tellTales: Slender windowless drone with a nose sensor ball and rear pusher propeller
Very long narrow wings with missile pylons

confusedWith.howToTell: The MQ-1C has a downward inverted V-tail and a slimmer body; the MQ-9 has an upward V-tail with a fin underneath and a fatter fuselage.

usCount.source: US Army / GA-ASI deliveries; FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2025
